# REA

> The pen only draws where the stylus touched.

REA lets an AI helper take apart programs you have no source for, and every claim comes with the place it was found.

This is an independent, art-directed explainer for morluto's REA — it takes a newcomer from "never seen it" to "ready to implement", grounded in a real RVF knowledge base of the source.

## What it is
REA: A drafting pantograph on vellum: the stylus arm traces a stranger's sealed mechanism while the linked pen arm redraws it to scale on your sheet — and the pen physically lifts off the paper wherever the stylus cannot reach.

## For your AI
A downloadable knowledge pack (RVF vector KB + MCP server) ships with this page so your agent can search the source too: https://rea-explainer.netlify.app/rea-knowledge-pack.zip
